page.notes: Italic and roman runs were judged from the scan and may be slightly off at boundaries. The drop cap T in "TOletus" is read as the initial of the author name. The hyphens in "Pri-mo", "insecti-libus", "no-ftra" and "con-" are printed line-end hyphens, kept as printed. The title "Quo quaedam concessa supponuntur." is read as a title above a passage, level 2. The running head is set in small capitals and was normalised to u for the vowel.
